title: Deniable Steganography
motivation: steganography faces coercive attack when steganalysis detects hidden messages; parties can be forced to disclose secrets
problem_framing: port deniable encryption concepts to steganography: embed fake message + real message, provide decoy decoder D_f for coercion
key_insight: use balanced message loss to ensure Dr and Df achieve equal extraction accuracy, making fake extraction plausible
method_signature: DNN-based encoder embeds real+fake messages; two decoders Dr/Df with balanced loss; adversarial training
evaluation_criteria: image quality (PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS), bit error rate, scalability to multiple decoders, sensitivity across architectures
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: fake messages are random bits lacking semantic plausibility; scheme sensitive to steganalysis attacks not tested
evidence_for_taste: the deniable scheme for steganography has not been reported
balance the extraction accuracy between the real and fake messages
our scheme is not sensitive to the network architectures
good scalability to the number of decoders
thinking_moves: 类比迁移：将deniable encryption概念跨领域移植到steganography
框架复用：在HiDDeN架构上添加decoder实现deniability，仅修改loss function
可扩展性验证：通过增加decoder数量测试方案的通用性
extraction_notes: paper lacks full experimental details on fake message generation; security proof incomplete; steganalysis resistance not evaluated against state-of-art detectors like ATS
